prompt: A small, paved shared back garden at night seen from a fixed high point on the wall of the house, looking down at a large grey wheelie bin standing between a rusting rotary washing line and a cracked patio slab. Brandon, small from above, stands up to his thighs in the bin in his pants, his arms wrapped tight round his chest, his shoulders hunched, his jaw clenched and trembling and his eyes wide and fixed on nothing. Bags of ice from a petrol station lie slumped on the ground beside the bin, and the water in the bin is dark with floating cubes. The only light is a harsh yellow lamp over a neighbour's back door, which leaves most of the garden in grain and deep shadow. Muted, compressed colour. Thanks.
